python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,http.client,pathlib,subprocess,sys
sha="9cc7726601401f20306cd4f355bc1dff3f3d3cfd"
token=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
def check(k,ok):
 print(k+"="+("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not ok:sys.exit(42)
def call(path,payload=None,auth=True):
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"}
 if auth:headers["Authorization"]="Bearer "+token
 try:
  c.request("POST" if payload is not None else "GET",path,
    body=json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None,headers=headers)
  r=c.getresponse()
  return r.status,r.read(2000000)
 finally:c.close()
local=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=8,check=True).stdout.strip()
check("SOURCE_SHA",local==sha)
status,raw=call("/healthz")
check("LIVE_SHA",status==200 and json.loads(raw).get("commit")==sha)
status,raw=call("/library?limit=1")
data=json.loads(raw) if status==200 else {}
check("LIBRARY_OWNER_READ",status==200 and data.get("verified") is True)
items=data.get("items",[])
if items:
 ident=items[0]["candidate_id"]
 status,raw=call("/library/selected",{"candidate_ids":[ident]})
 selected=json.loads(raw) if status==200 else {}
 check("CROSS_PAGE_EXACT_SELECTION",status==200 and selected.get("verified") is True and selected["items"][0]["candidate_id"]==ident)
else:
 status,_=call("/library/selected",{"candidate_ids":["absent:123"]})
 check("SELECTION_ROUTE_SAFE_EMPTY_DB",status==400)
status,_=call("/library/selected",{"candidate_ids":["absent:123"]},auth=False)
check("SELECTION_REJECTS_UNAUTHORIZED",status==401)
status,js=call("/app.js")
check("LIVE_GALLERY_AND_POST_PAGING",status==200 and b'references.slice(offset,offset+50)' in js and b'view.action==="tumblr.list_posts"' in js and b'/library/selected' in js)
for suite in ("test_tumblr_read.py","test_library.py","test_app_serve.py","test_operation_app.py"):
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p",suite,"-q"],capture_output=True,timeout=45)
 check("OFFLINE_"+suite,p.returncode==0)
print("TUMBLR_PROVIDER_CALLS=ZERO")
print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS")
PY
